WITH source_stats AS (
  SELECT
    p.fundflux,
    AVG(1.0 * ss.boxy / ss.boxz) AS avg_ratio,
    COUNT(DISTINCT p.arcregistry) AS project_count
  FROM projects AS p
  JOIN scanspatial AS ss ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY p.fundflux
),
source_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(project_count) AS avg_project_count
  FROM source_stats
),
kept AS (
  SELECT s.avg_ratio, s.project_count, a.avg_project_count
  FROM source_stats AS s
  CROSS JOIN source_average AS a
  WHERE s.project_count > a.avg_project_count
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_ratio,
  SUM(project_count) AS total_distinct_projects,
  AVG(project_count - avg_project_count) AS average_excess_project_count
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: Funding sources are grouped by their stored value, with NULL treated as its own group. Only projects with at least one matching spatial record are included; each project is counted once per source, and each spatial record with non-NULL boxy and nonzero, non-NULL boxz contributes to the ratio average.
